records.title: Learning Theory of Transformers: Local-to-Global Approximation via Softmax Partition of Unity
records.reason: Approximation/learning theory for transformer regression, without an inference optimization.

records.title: EnvSimBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Improving LLM-Based Environment Simulation
records.reason: EnvSimBench evaluates LLM-based environment simulation and proposes a constrained 4B simulator that cuts environment-synthesis cost by over 90% while improving yield; this is cost efficiency for a specialized agent-training simulator, not a general inference/serving optimization.

records.title: Quantifying modality imbalance and visual jailbreak robustness in LLaVA via projected gradient descent
records.reason: Visual jailbreak robustness/attack evaluation for LLaVA; no inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
records.reason: RGAO routes multi-agent code tasks to topologies using a retrieval-derived complexity vector and enforces budget conservation; it reports proxy misrouting reduction from 30.1% to 8.2% and sub-millisecond DAG construction, but end-to-end inference cost/latency savings are not established in the reviewed evaluation.

records.title: Adaptive Selection of LoRA Components in Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning
records.reason: Privacy-preserving federated LoRA training component selection, not deployment-time inference optimization.
